latest.title: Claas Lexion 7000 and 8000 series combines: More choice. More buying homework
latest.originalTitle: Claas Lexion 7000 and 8000 series combines: More choice. More buying homework
latest.summary: 農業機械の新製品・技術・現場動向を紹介する海外記事です。
latest.originalSummary: USED MACHINERY: If you home in on a Claas Lexion hybrid as your next used combine choice, take a deep breath. When we last looked at buying a Lexion 700 back in 2017, matters were relatively straightforward. Fast forward to 2026, and the narrow body Lexion 7000 (and wide body 8000) are rather different to their predecessors. Add a broader range of header types, the wide adoption of tracks plus numerous other options and the points to consider may be more involved than you might think.
